text:
alana-docs: opened PR for docs: add a short KMS/HSM proxy + cert rotation section for airgapped installs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5120

mike-eng: TL;DR: customers mirror public KMS endpoints to internal hosts and use an SNI proxy. When rotating the internal cert, some nodes fail to validate TLS because the installer chroot uses an old CA bundle. Need a small playbook + snippets.

alana-docs: proposed playbook in PR: 1) stage new CA in extra_certs_dir on all bootstrap hosts; 2) restart containerd and any proxy; 3) verify with `openssl s_client -connect internal.kms:443 -servername kms.redwood.ai -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt`; 4) run a smoke pull of a signed manifest; 5) remove old CA after all nodes report OK. Added this to the PR.

jess-sre: add a snippet for pre-sealed hosts where chroot isn't yet populated: copy the CA into the chroot path used by the installer (`/host-chroot/etc/ssl/certs/`) and touch a marker file so the installer picks it up. Example:```sh
mkdir -p /opt/redwood/installer/extra-certs
cp new-root-ca.pem /opt/redwood/installer/extra-certs/
# installer copies to chroot during unpack; for immediate check copy directly
cp new-root-ca.pem /host-chroot/etc/ssl/certs/ca-new.pem
chroot /host-chroot update-ca-certificates || true
```

mike-eng: also include note for container runtimes other than containerd (cri-o, docker). For cri-o the cert goes under `/etc/containers/certs.d/<registry>/ca.crt`. Small table would help but keep it one-liner per runtime.

alana-docs: added runtime one-liners. Also added a short HSM caveat: if the HSM is fronted by a proxy that terminates TLS, ensure the proxy preserves client cert/SNI if customers use mutual TLS to the HSM.

hira-cs: customer question: how to validate post-rotation without downtime? can we recommend canary approach?

jess-sre: yes. recommend canary: update CA on a single bootstrap host, run smoke pulls and `p11tool --list-objects` against the HSM (if applicable), then incrementally roll. Added a tiny checklist and the openssl verification command to the PR.

infra-bot: CI: docs-lint + linkcheck started for PR #5120.

mike-eng: small security note: never embed private keys in the extra_certs_dir. Document that only public CA certs are allowed and recommend using transient access controls for the bundle.

alana-docs: done. i'll squash and merge after CI. tagging @jess-sre to run the smoke-runner once merged. :thumbsup:
